thread.title: Apple's stock drops as Trump's tariffs comments add to investor agita, analyst says - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple's stock drops as Trump's tariffs comments add to investor agita, analyst says - MarketWatch
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.35% slumped 2.1% in premarket trade Tuesday, after President Trump told The Wall Street Journal tariffs could be placed on iPhones , which are produced in China. Wedbush analyst Daniel Ives said Trump's comments adds to the current "white knuckle" period for Apple, which has been hit with a "litany of bad news" including the pulling of iPhone sales metrics and data suggesting softer initial demand for new iPhones. "With [average selling prices] for the iPhone in the $800 range and consumers clearly price sensitive around higher smartphone prices the last thing [CEO Tim] Cook and investors want to see is additional tariffs added to iPhones and impacting demand drivers at this crucial growth juncture for the company," Ives wrote in a note to clients. "While we are taking a wait and see approach around if this talk is more bark than bite from the Trump administration, we could see a negative knee jerk reaction to this latest tariff news in Apple shares that will add to the agita currently around the name." The stock has tumbled 20% over the past three months through Monday, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +1.46% has slipped 5.4%.
